description: This bar chart illustrates the average number of likes per post across five distinct groups of posts, categorized by their similarity to other posts, with the horizontal axis labeled “Most similar group of posts” and displaying five categories: (0,90], (90,180], (180,270], (270,360], and (360,450]. The vertical axis is labeled “Avg. Like #” and uses a linear scale ranging from 400 to 600, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 50. Each bar is light blue and represents the mean average likes for its respective group, with error bars extending vertically above each bar indicating variability. The first bar, corresponding to the (0,90] group, reaches approximately 600 likes. The second bar, for the (90,180] group, is slightly lower at approximately 565 likes. The third bar, for the (180,270] group, is approximately 570 likes. The fourth bar, for the (270,360] group, reaches approximately 595 likes. The fifth bar, for the (360,450] group, is approximately 590 likes. The bars are arranged in ascending order of their group’s lower bound, from left to right, and there are no visual annotations or special emphasis on any particular bar.
